login.title: Welcome back!
login.description: Login to your account to manage your budget.
login.toastSuccessBody: You have been logged in, redirecting to the dashboard.

register.title: Register!
register.description: Create a new account to start planning your finances.
register.usernamePattern: Username can only contain letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-'.
register.toastSuccessBodyAuto: You have successfully registered, you will be redirected to the dashboard.
register.toastSuccessBodyEmail: Check your inbox to confirm your account.
register.toastValidationBody: One or more validation errors occurred.

confirm.pendingDescription: Hang tight — this only takes a second.
confirm.successDescription: Your account is confirmed. Sign in to start tracking your money with Centsible.
confirm.errorTitle: This link is invalid or expired
confirm.errorDescription: We couldn't confirm your account. Confirmation links expire after 24 hours — request a new one by registering again.

checkEmail.title: Check your inbox
checkEmail.descriptionWithEmail: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Click the link in that email to activate your account.
checkEmail.descriptionGeneric: We sent you a confirmation link. Click the link in that email to activate your account.
checkEmail.expiryNote: The link expires in 24 hours. If you don't see the email after a minute or two, check your spam folder.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot your password?
forgotPassword.description: Enter your username and we'll email you a link to choose a new password.
forgotPassword.submittedDescription: If an account exists for that username, we just sent a password reset link to its email address.
forgotPassword.expiryNote: The link expires in 15 minutes. If you don't see the email after a minute or two, check your spam folder.
forgotPassword.toastSuccessBody: If that account exists, you'll receive an email shortly.
forgotPassword.toastErrorBody: Please try again in a moment.

resetPassword.title: Choose a new password
resetPassword.description: Enter a new password for your account.
resetPassword.successDescription: Your password has been changed. Sign in with your new password to continue.
resetPassword.invalidTitle: This link is invalid or expired
resetPassword.invalidDescription: Password reset links expire after 15 minutes. Request a new one to try again.
resetPassword.toastSuccessBody: Your password has been changed successfully.
resetPassword.toastErrorBody: Please try again in a moment.
resetPassword.toastInvalidLinkBody: This link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.
resetPassword.toastValidationBody: One or more validation errors occurred.
